name: typescript-expert
description: Use for TypeScript types, generics, narrowing, API contracts, strict mode, reusable frontend models, and safe refactoring.
---

# TypeScript Expert

- Prefer strict typing and useful inference.
- Avoid `any`; use `unknown` and narrow when input is genuinely unknown.
- Model API contracts explicitly.
- Use discriminated unions for state variants.
- Keep generics constrained and readable.
- Avoid type assertions that bypass real validation.
- Distinguish compile-time types from runtime validation.
